mapper.select: SELECT 'ALL' value,'ALL' label FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G value ,EQP_G label FROM( SELECT DISTINCT EQPID FROM A1MFG.V_PB11_EVENT_ALARM )A JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD B ON A.EQPID = B.EQP_ID WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND MODULE = #{module,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT EQP_G,EQP_ID,MODULE,UNIT_ID,UNIT_FLAG,OCCUR_TIME,F_COMMENT FROM( SELECT B.EQP_G,B.MODULE,A.EQPID EQP_ID ,SUBSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,1,INSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,'_')-1)UNIT_ID ,SUBSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,INSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,'_')+1)UNIT_FLAG ,A.OCCUR_TIME,C.F_COMMENT FROM A1MFG.V_PB11_EVENT_ALARM A LEFT JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD B ON A.EQPID = B.EQP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 EQP_ID,KEY2 UNIT_ID,KEY3 OCCUR_TIME,F_COMMENT FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME ='EQP_UNIT_MONITOR' )C ON A.EQPID = C.EQP_ID AND SUBSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,1,INSTR(A.ALARM_TEXT2,'_')-1)=C.UNIT_ID AND TO_CHAR(A.OCCUR_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')=C.OCCUR_TIME WHERE 1=1 -- 模糊查询
AND A.EQPID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{eqpId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND A.OCCUR_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYYMMDD')+7.5/24
AND A.OCCUR_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYYMMDD')+1+7.5/24
)WHERE 1=1 --模糊查询
and UNIT_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{unitId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and UNIT_FLAG = #{unitFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY OCCUR_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: merge into PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY A using( SELECT 'EQP_UNIT_MONITOR' FUNCTION_NAME,#{eqpId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY1,#{unitId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY2,#{occurTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY3, #{fcomment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}F_COMMENT,#{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL )B ON (A.FUNCTION_NAME = B.FUNCTION_NAME AND A.KEY1 = B.KEY1 and A.KEY2 = B.KEY2 AND A.KEY3 = B.KEY3) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER,A.UPDATE_TIME=B.UPDATE_TIME,A.F_COMMENT=B.F_COMMENT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FUNCTION_NAME, KEY1, KEY2,KEY3,F_COMMENT,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME)VALUES(B.FUNCTION_NAME, B.KEY1, B.KEY2,B.KEY3,B.F_COMMENT,B.UPDATE_USER,B.UPDATE_TIME)
